audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is marked 'Skill' and First item is marked Garen; the packet chart gives Garen every stage through Level 6 and Malphite both item stages.
audit.why: The prose already matches the packet, not the tokens — 'Level 6 your lane lead holds' is a Garen row, and 'First item his armor starts neutralizing your all-AD damage' is a Malphite row. The mirror (malphite vs garen) is built on the same shape, so leaving this would put the two directions in conflict.
audit.corrected: Flipped win[4] and win[5] with phases[4] and phases[5] side/rating as one group, and gave phases[5] a real why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why was the placeholder 'Completed baseline component combat alignment shifts.'
audit.why: First item is the stage the matchup turns on — his first armour piece — and the row said nothing.
audit.corrected: Named the armour item as the reason the stage flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields say Malphite's armour blunts Garen's R — 'your physical E and R damage falls off a cliff', 'R barely dents him', 'stacked armor fully counters your physical kit', 'gut your physical E and R'.
audit.why: Demacian Justice deals true damage. Armour does nothing to it — that is the single reason Garen can still kill an armour-stacked Malphite, and it is exactly what the mirror audit established from the other side. Also unstated: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges when he goes unhit, so poking it off before you commit is what makes the all-in land, and Thunderclap is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, whys[6], content.late, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.
